status: CURRENT implementation and test navigation; per-predicate audit and consolidated qualification required before milestone completion

command-and-digest.boundary: Private serialized command time/token and trigger-only pure/scoped validators; missing functions fail closed. Exact JSON numbers, UTF-16 ordering and historical digests use versioned contract helpers.

populations.boundary: Serialized full-frame freeze, exact source identity/content, exclusions, deterministic draw and mandatory reciprocal finalization. Plain SQL views/maintenance need no validator functions.

studies.boundary: Immutable ordered event histories, owner/member checks, exact retained closure bundles, deadline retry, and scoped payload rederivation; current projections derive from committed evidence.

taxonomy.boundary: Complete successor code sets, permanent retirements, exact observation assignments and shared coverage reducer; per-command finalization rejects trailing writes.

promotion.boundary: Closed-study/current-taxonomy support, complete criterion/development exposure/handoff bundles, one exact candidate truth/regression copy; finalizers rederive retained lineage.

lifecycle.boundary: Exact candidate/transition raw digests, live owner, predecessor CAS, activation evidence and reciprocal replacement finalization; revocation changes the current head atomically. Consumer authorizations bind the exact current head.

calibration.boundary: Fenced durable run/attempt ownership; protected-revision lease; complete immutable public/private artifact bundle. Application eligibility semantics match PG; database checks snapshot digests/ownership and rederives terminal bytes.

governed-subjects.boundary: Durable per-project human identity; account erasure removes account linkage but retains governed subject evidence.

identity-claims.boundary: Permanent tenant-scoped input-class claims and reverse overlap checks. Competing serialized commands cannot place one input in sealed and nonsealed classes.

instructions.boundary: Immutable authored instruction version binds an exact criterion and known subject with retained content digest.

imported-truth.boundary: Immutable imported annotations retain provenance and known/unknown author status; do not imply governed independent truth.

development.boundary: Evaluator authorship and durable development events are exact immutable evidence; missing/unspecified identities cannot become recorded by projection.

capabilities.boundary: Live independent-identity and content-exposure eligibility, exact scoped snapshot/digests; rejected checks commit evidence while protected operations remain blocked.

review-items.boundary: Projected safe payloads, exact criterion/input identity and permanent structural claims; unsafe or cross-bound items fail before commit.

review-drafts.boundary: Exact sampled batch/frame/tasks; actor/source/selection lineage and complete per-command bundle. Sealed intake has dedicated exposure and successor checks.

review-streams.boundary: Immutable batch/task CAS streams and blind views; protected reads rederive live separation before replay; current SQL head views preserve event order.

labels.boundary: Exact active independent labels and reciprocal submission event; withdrawals cannot remove revealed evidence. Common barrier is a complete current label set.

alignment.boundary: Complete exact label-set links and histories; no omitted/forged labels or post-finalization mutation.

adjudication.boundary: Supersession chain and exact complete supporting label set, authorized independent decision and retained immutable history.

truth.boundary: Exact resolved truth links and full frozen revision finalization; protected sealed successor rules; candidate copies have a narrowly claimed byte-identical variant.

datasets.boundary: Immutable finalized revision/item/exposure evidence, tenant/criterion ownership and exact digests; protected source payloads survive retention; project erasure is explicit.

definitions.boundary: Exact criterion/version and authorship binding. Native and promoted paths remain distinct; mutable status/current pointers do not mutate immutable version content.

evaluation.boundary: Tenant-bound immutable assessment receipt bytes/lineage and revision membership; fenced execution and reciprocal terminal receipt release; corrections remain append-only.

suites.boundary: Retained exact manifest BLOB contains all ordered members; SQLite has no separate mutable member table. Publication rechecks current lifecycle eligibility; immutable comparisons bind exact revisions.

regression.boundary: Exact regression revision and evaluator identity; fenced provider-start uncertainty, retained immutable result, activation requires full passed coverage without override.

legacy-review.boundary: Pinned historical review queue/run/criterion evidence and verdict scope; immutable context pins prevent pairing unrelated evidence.

imports.boundary: Import jobs bind immutable evaluator versions within the tenant; implicit selection uses current lifecycle eligibility.

production.boundary: Ungoverned monitoring remains separate from governed evidence; immutable decision/snapshot/tombstone records and exact digest/time provenance with explicit erasure obligations.

shared-immutability.boundary: Common PG append-only functions are implemented by table-specific UPDATE/DELETE triggers. Per-table inventory entries below identify concrete suites; project/user erasure exceptions are deliberate.
